minimum_charge_rule_basis: Each account SWMS = max(allocated share, minimum); same rule for baseline and credited bills. Tariff 2026-09-01 sections 4.3(a)(6), 4.3(a)(8), 4.5(b); manual section 4.3.5 step 5; PWD stormwater billing FAQ (water.phila.gov/stormwater/billing/, retrieved 2026-11-16): each account is assigned its share and if that value is less than the Minimum Charge, the minimum applies.
unsupported_combinations: New benefits with existing NPDES without detailed approved ledger
Overlapping benefit ledger IDs without resolved sequencing
Aggregate existing credits with corrections or new benefits before spatial reconciliation
Standalone green-roof/porous IAR without reconciled current authorization
NPDES with IAR GA allocation unresolved
Legacy charge-based NPDES baseline with new benefits until area-ledger reconciliation
fractional_curve_number_policy: Whole CN steps below 75 (manual 4.3.3.1: a percent reduction for each whole number below a CN of 75), i.e. steps = floor(75 - average CN); average summed in Decimal from area x CN (Appendix A steps 3-5)
money_rounding_policy: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP per GA/IA component, allocated account SWMS and final discounted account total; per-account minimum after allocation; reconcile with actual bill
source_download_status: Current manual and tariff original PDF bytes captured locally with SHA-256 after initial restricted DNS failure.
